question: Should OpenClaw accept fail-closed validation for byte-size config values above `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`, or require an upgrade/doctor path before merging this PR?
rationale: The patch is the right parser fix, but it intentionally changes existing config validation behavior for already-written unsafe numeric values.

options.title: Accept safe-integer rejection
options.body: Merge the bug fix as-is and treat previously accepted unsafe byte-size values as invalid because OpenClaw could not represent them exactly.

options.title: Add upgrade handling first
options.body: Ask for a doctor warning/fix or clearer upgrade path before merge so existing invalid configs get a guided recovery path.

recommendation.title: Accept safe-integer rejection
recommendation.body: Merge the bug fix as-is and treat previously accepted unsafe byte-size values as invalid because OpenClaw could not represent them exactly.

likelyOwner.reason: The nearest feature-history trail for shared CLI/config parsing and session maintenance points to this area work.
